mentions.name: Segue
mentions.description: An infinite canvas, keyboard-first mind mapping application for Windows desktops. It keeps a minimal feature set of text nodes, sticky notes, an ink tool, and images. Everything is fully local with no servers, accounts, sign-in, or sync settings; each board is saved as a SQLite database file that users can sync themselves via git or OneDrive. The app is open source under the MIT license and built in C# with SkiaSharp for the canvas and WPF UI.
